results.note: Commentarius praevius (Auctor incertus, PL 162). Medieval prefatory commentary; no English translation found. Generic Latin title with no identifiable author or content details to enable finding a translation.
Donationes piae (Auctor incertus, PL 162). Medieval work on pious donations to the church; no English translation found in searches. Specialized ecclesiastical topic with limited modern scholarship.
Narratio vexationum (Auctor incertus, PL 162). Medieval narrative work; no English translation found. Obscure title and anonymous authorship limit discoverability.

Gesta episcoporum Metensium (Auctor incertus, PL 163). Medieval chronicle of bishops of Metz; while Paul the Deacon wrote a famous Gesta episcoporum Mettensium (~783), searches found no English translation of either version, and the Auctor incertus attribution suggests a different or derivative work.
Chronicon Affligemense (Auctor incertus, PL 166). Medieval chronicle from Affligem Abbey; no English translation found despite specific search for this chronicle title.
Epitaphia antiqua (Auctor incertus, PL 166). Collection of ancient epitaphs/inscriptions; no English translation found. Medieval compilations of epitaphs typically lack modern translations.
Rhythmus antiquus (Auctor incertus, PL 166). Medieval poem/rhythmic composition; no English translation found. Specialized medieval poetry forms rarely translated.

Quaestio (Auctor incertus, PL 170). Generic medieval theological question; too generic a title to determine if any specific translation exists without examining the manuscript itself. May be part of a larger work or exist as standalone piece.

Vita S. Norberti (Auctor incertus, PL 170). Saint Norbert's life (Vita B); confirmed English translation available through Premontre.org and published by Norbertine Sisters as 900th Jubilee Commemorative Edition. Vita A also has English translation based on Monumenta edition.

Expositio in Cantica Canticorum (Auctor incertus, PL 172). Commentary on Song of Songs; while named commentaries by Honorius Augustodunensis and Williram of Ebersberg have translations, searches did not confirm English translation for this anonymous version. May be excerpt or compilation.

Vita (Auctor incertus, PL 173). Generic title 'Vita' (life/biography); too generic to determine subject or translation status without examining the work directly. Could be saints' life or biographical work.

Chronicon Aldenburgense majus (Auctor incertus, PL 174). Medieval chronicle from Aldenburg; no English translation found despite specific search. Related chronicle (Chronicon Aldenburgense) also lacks identified English translation.
Chronicon Aldenburgense (Auctor incertus, PL 174). Medieval chronicle from Aldenburg; no English translation found. Medieval German chronicles of this type typically remain in Latin.

Sermo de vita Arnulfi (Auctor incertus, PL 174). Sermon about/life of Arnulf (likely Saint Arnulf of Soissons); BHL 689-692 texts exist in scholarly literature (Brepols edition), but no specific English translation found for this sermon version.
De nuptiis (Auctor incertus, PL 176). Medieval theological treatise on marriage; distinct from Martianus Capella's classical work; no English translation found for this anonymous medieval version.

Collationes de verbo incarnato (Auctor incertus, PL 177). Collations on the Incarnation; while Hugh of St. Victor wrote works with this title, no English translation found for this anonymous version in volume 177.

De anima (Auctor incertus, PL 177). Treatise on the soul; numerous medieval works bore this title (Aristotle commentaries, theological works), but no English translation found for this specific anonymous version.

De filia Jephthe (Auctor incertus, PL 177). Biblical theological work on Jephthah's daughter; while Abelard wrote 'Planctus virginum Israel super filia Jephte,' no English translation found for this anonymous treatise.

De unione corporis et spiritus (Auctor incertus, PL 177). Theological treatise on body-spirit union; no English translation found. Scholastic philosophical topic rarely addressed in medieval translations.
Excerptiones allegoricae (Auctor incertus, PL 177). Allegorical excerpts; no English translation found. Compilation of extracts from unidentified sources.

Sermo de assumptione B. Virginis (Auctor incertus, PL 177). Sermon on Assumption of Virgin Mary; generic sermon title; no specific English translation found. Medieval Marian sermon collections typically lack modern translations.

Speculum de mysteriis ecclesiae (Auctor incertus, PL 177). Mirror/overview of church mysteries; while 12th-century Victorine works with similar titles exist, no English translation found for this anonymous version. Searches reference Victorine theological tradition but no specific translation.
Hymnus de S. Malachia (Auctor incertus, PL 182). Hymn to Saint Malachia (Malachy); no English translation found. Medieval saint hymns rarely translated.

Flores seu sententiae ex S. Bernardo (Auctor incertus, PL 183). Excerpts/maxims from Bernard of Clairvaux, compiled by anonymous editor; no English translation found for this compilation, though Bernard's original works are translated.

Ad clerum in concilio Remensi congregatum (Auctor incertus, PL 184). Address to clergy at Council of Reims; no English translation found. Specialized ecclesiastical text with limited scholarly attention.

Bernardus de contemptu mundi (Auctor incertus, PL 184). While Bernard of Cluny's 'De contemptu mundi' has English translation by Ronald E. Pepin, the batch work's attribution to 'Auctor incertus' suggests this may be a different compilation or excerpt. No confirmed translation for anonymous version.
Carmen paraeneticum (Auctor incertus, PL 184). Paraenetic (exhortatory) poem; no English translation found. Medieval Latin poetry of this type rarely translated.
De B. Virgine Maria (Auctor incertus, PL 184). Theological treatise on Virgin Mary; generic Marian theology title; no specific English translation found.
De conscientia (Auctor incertus, PL 184). Treatise on conscience; no English translation found. Scholastic philosophical topic with limited medieval translation tradition.
De excellentia SS. Sacramenti (Auctor incertus, PL 184). On the excellence of the Sacrament; no English translation found. Medieval Eucharistic theology treatise.

De miseria humana (Auctor incertus, PL 184). On human misery; while Pope Innocent III wrote famous 'De miseria humane condicionis,' searches found no translation for this anonymous version in volume 184.

De modo bene vivendi (Auctor incertus, PL 184). Has medieval English translation 'The Manere of Good Lyvyng' (Pseudo-Bernard's Liber de modo bene vivendi ad sororem), edited by Anne E. Mouron, published by Brepols (Medieval Women: Texts and Contexts series, 2014) with critical apparatus.
De ordine vitae (Auctor incertus, PL 184). On the order/discipline of life; no English translation found. Medieval monastic/ascetical theology.
De septem donis Spiritus Sancti (Auctor incertus, PL 184). On the seven gifts of the Holy Spirit; no English translation found. Medieval pneumatological treatise.
De statu virtutum (Auctor incertus, PL 184). On the state/status of virtues; no English translation found. Medieval virtue ethics treatise.

De vita et passione Domini seu Stimulus amoris (Auctor incertus, PL 184). The 'Stimulus amoris' (Goad of Love) by James of Milan has medieval English translation 'The Pricking of Love' and 17th-century translation by B. Lewis Augustine. However, batch work's attribution to 'Auctor incertus' and inclusion of 'De vita et passione Domini' suggests possible composite or different version; unclear if identical to known Stimulus amoris translation.

De vita monastica (Auctor incertus, PL 184). On monastic life; no specific English translation found. Medieval monastic rule/guidance literature rarely translated unless from major figures like Benedict.
Disputatio cujusdam justi cum Deo (Auctor incertus, PL 184). Disputation of a just man with God; no English translation found. Medieval dialogue/disputatio form rarely translated.
Documenta varia et brevia (Auctor incertus, PL 184). Various brief teachings/documents; too generic; no English translation found. Miscellaneous compilation.

In antiphonam Salve Regina (Auctor incertus, PL 184). Commentary on Salve Regina antiphon; while Bernard of Clairvaux wrote famous Salve Regina commentary, no English translation found for this anonymous version. Searches confirm antiphon authorship disputed but no translation for this sermon/commentary.

In assumptione B. Virginis Mariae (Auctor incertus, PL 184). Sermon on Assumption of Virgin Mary; generic liturgical sermon title; no specific English translation found. Medieval Marian liturgical homilies typically lack modern translations.
In coena Domini (Auctor incertus, PL 184). On Lord's Supper; generic Eucharistic sermon title; no specific English translation found.

In feria II Paschatis (Auctor incertus, PL 184). Sermon for Easter Monday (Feria II of Easter week); generic liturgical sermon; no specific English translation found. Medieval liturgical homilies rarely translated except major authors.

In nativitate S. Joannis Baptistae (Auctor incertus, PL 184). Sermon on Nativity of John the Baptist; generic feast-day sermon; no English translation found. Medieval liturgical homilies lack systematic translation.

In orationem Dominicam (Auctor incertus, PL 184). Sermon/commentary on Lord's Prayer; generic title; no specific English translation found. Medieval homilies on Our Father rarely translated as discrete works.
